skills.name: Mana Stars
skills.description:
Launches your mana as a razor-sharp crystal, dealing 20 (0 + 50% Magic Attack) Magic Damage. 
Each consecutive Mana Star increases in damage +2%, up to a max of 20%.
Each Mana Star inflicts Fetter on the target, reducing their damage  -1% and move speed -2% per stack. Stacks up to 20 times.
Does not cause a global cooldown. Hold down for continuous use.

skills.gcdNote: No GCD; continuous rapid-fire (~0.30s/star base, scales with Atk Spd & ping)

skills.name: Mana Stars (Wave)
skills.description:
Launches your mana as painful bursts of energy, dealing 20 (0 + 50% Magic Attack) Magic Damage. Each consecutive Mana Star increases the caster's Move Speed +2%, up to  a max of +20%.
Each projectile also inflicts Fetter on the target, reducing their damage -1% and Move Speed -2% per stack. Stacks up to 20 times.
Does not cause a global cooldown. Hold down for continuous use.

skills.name: Mana Stars (Quake)
skills.description:
Launches your mana as explosive orbs, dealing 20 (0 + 50% Magic Attack) Magic Damage to all enemies in a 6m radius around the target. Each consecutive Mana Star increases in damage +2%, up to a max of 20%.
Inflicts Fetter on each enemy hit, reducing their damage -1% and Move Speed -2% per stack. Stacks up to 20 times.
When using Caster's Enrichment, this skill grants a stack of Burning Brand for each enemy hit.
Hold down for continuous use.

skills.name: Mana Force
skills.description:
Pushes an enemy away, dealing 361 (278 + 200% Magic Attack) Magic Damage. Restores Mana equal to half that amount.
Pushed enemies are Staggered, briefly stopping movement and canceling all Cast Time and Channeled skills.
This skill counts as a Push effect.

skills.name: Absorb Lifeforce
skills.description:
Inflicts a debuff which deals 1297 (1152 + 350% Magic Attack) Magic Damage to the enemy over 6.5 seconds, healing the caster for half the amount.
Inflicts an additional +140% on pets.
This debuff ends early if the caster stops channeling, or if the target moves far enough away from the caster.
